कु॑तस् adv. whence? whither? wherefore? why? how? Also =
abl. of the inter. pron.;
 w. अपि, चन & चिद from any (side), w. neg.
from no side, from nowhere.

कुतुक n. curiosity, eagerness, interest;
 desire for (—˚).

कुतूहलवन्त् a. curious, eager, interested in
anything.
कुतूह˚लिन् a. curious, eager, interested in anything.
कु॑त्स m. N. of a Ṛṣi etc.

कुत्सय् कुत्स˚यति pp. कुत्सत revile, abuse,
blame.—अभि & अव = S.
